excel_rule: whole-row insertion shifts references at or below the insertion
whole-column insertion shifts references at or right of the insertion
cell insertion adjusts references inside the shifted column band
cell insertion leaves references outside the shifted column band unchanged
cell insertion adjusts references inside the shifted row band
moving cells retargets dependents to the destination
local row insertion must not shift an external workbook reference
local row deletion must not invalidate an external workbook reference
local column insertion must not shift an external workbook reference
local column deletion must not invalidate an external workbook reference
moving local cells must not retarget an external workbook reference
local cell insertion must not shift an external workbook reference
